summary: Aphrody is a gifted, graceful leader who began as a self-declared god, was beaten, dropped the shortcut, and came back as a teammate, teacher and defender of the game. Pride became humility without losing elegance.

items.text: He plays and carries himself as an artist: beauty and elegance are how he competes, to the point that opponents are charmed instead of intimidated.

evidence.quote: His elegant, artistic style leaves his opponents spellbound.
Captivating the opposition with artistic grace, he plays with the aura of a deity from on high.
芸術的なプレイで敵をも魅了する。

items.text: A divine bearing: golden glow, a god's beauty, the Zeus pantheon around him, a name taken from Aphrodite. Others address him with reverence ('Lord Aphrody', 'hallowed god').

evidence.quote: His appearance is as beautiful as a God's.
O hallowed god Aphrody... praise be thy name.
a figure surrounded by a golden glow showed up and nobly approached them, like a divine descending from heavens

items.text: He analyses first and acts second; he reads a match like a coach and says what he sees without softening it.

evidence.quote: He seems to be the kind of person who analyzes first, and then makes actions.
Aphrodi explained that he only told them what he saw.
Il est un bon stratège, même s'il n'égale pas Jude Sharp sur ce point.

items.text: Strong-willed, trusting and perceptive once the pride is gone; likable and loyal to the people he plays with.

evidence.quote: he is revealed to have a likable personality - strong willed, trustful and perceptive.
capable de se sacrifier pour ses amis

items.text: He puts his body on the line for the team and for others: he collapses against Chaos, protects Aki, and helps Fubuki recover.

evidence.quote: gets injured in the process and finally collapses
he was one of the catalysts that helped Fubuki recover from his split personality

items.text: Warm and a little playful with teammates: he plans a day at an amusement park as training and smiles at the result.

evidence.quote: Aphrodi stated with smile that they had a good time together, clearly satisfied with his idea.
Aphrodi explained that it was all to prepare the new technique.

items.text: Calm under pressure: he walks through a defence instead of running, and answers insults with a smile.

evidence.quote: Instead of running he was just standing calmly, watching the approaching opponent's players.
Aphrodi slowly raised his hand and initiated his signature technique Heaven's Time.

items.text: In the Zeus era he was arrogant, high-seated and proud, boasting about his talent and thinking only of power; this is the old self the arc leaves behind.

evidence.quote: During the Football Frontier arc, Aphrodi is quite arrogant, high-seated, and proud.
Byron avait tendance à se vanter, à être trop sûr de son talent et de la victoire de son équipe.
Goal! Foolish mortals...

items.text: He loves the game itself and takes responsibility for how it is played.

evidence.quote: he can't [quit] because he truly loves soccer, and that he intends to do things right by taking responsibility for his actions and start over
because they acted against soccer, they wouldn't be forgiven ... he was going to defeat them in order to protect soccer

items.text: Losing is how people grow; defeat is information, not shame.

evidence.quote: That loss taught me something. Falling down is how humans grow.
There are some things that you can only gain by losing.

items.text: No borrowed power: after the Aqua of the Gods he refuses shortcuts and relies on training.

evidence.quote: Never again will I foolishly rely on ambrosia.
he set aside the Aqua of the Gods and began to train by himself

items.text: Friendship and the team matter more than power.

evidence.quote: L'équipe Raimon lui avait appris que l'amitié était plus importante que le pouvoir.
We'll fight for our own sakes and win!

items.text: He steps in to keep players from harming themselves and each other, and lets them choose their own path instead of a ruling body's.

evidence.quote: Aphrodi became Kidokawa Seishuu's coach to protect the players from destroying themselves with their violent soccer.
Not for Fifth Sector, nor for the revolution.

items.text: He says the uncomfortable thing plainly (Raimon cannot win like this) and then helps fix it.

evidence.quote: he said straight that in the current situation, there was no way they could win any next match
they were equally guilty of the team's weaknesses

items.text: A chosen god: captain of Zeus, powered by the Aqua of the Gods, certain of victory.

evidence.quote: He was selected by Kageyama Reiji to play as the captain of Zeus.
Foolish mortals...

items.text: The fall: Endou's Majin The Hand stops God Knows; he is shocked, drops the drink and trains.

evidence.quote: Aphrodi was shocked that Zeus lost and since then he trained hard without the Aqua of the Gods.

items.text: Humility and belonging: he asks to join the team that beat him, earns the ball with the first goal, and plays as one of them.

evidence.quote: I'd like to join the Raimon team.
Aphrodi then shows he wasn't lying when he scores the first goal for Raimon

items.text: Sacrifice: he breaks himself against Chaos and mends Fubuki's confidence from a hospital bed.

evidence.quote: gets injured in the process and finally collapses

items.text: Leader among equals: in Fire Dragon he recruits rivals (Gazel, Burn), is friendly to Endou and still tells him the match will be theirs.

evidence.quote: he scouted Suzuno Fuusuke (Gazel) and Nagumo Haruya (Burn) to join Korea's national team
il se montre très amical envers Mark, mais il le prévient que son équipe remportera le match

items.text: Guardian and teacher: as Kirkwood's coach he refuses to pick a faction and lets the match show the way.

evidence.quote: Give it your all against Raimon. Do that, and the true path will reveal itself!

items.text: A god who chose to play among humans: he gave up the throne ('descended'), accepts that gods sometimes win and sometimes lose, and defends the game.

evidence.quote: he decided to descend and play with humans in this battlefield
gods were different, sometimes they were winning and sometimes they were losing
If a 'God' exists, then he can never be truly forgiven for it ... [she] remarks that he is then a god in training

items.text: Greek mythology and the pantheon: Aphrodite, Zeus, ambrosia, laurel wreath armband, 'God of the Pitch'.

evidence.quote: a reference to his profile and to Zeus' naming motif
Son brassard de capitaine est en forme de couronne de laurier.

items.text: Gold light, wings, thunder and wind: God Knows opens with wings of light and ends in thunder; Heaven's Time is a snap of the fingers; the French lettering of God Knows, God Break and Divine Arrow is blue.

evidence.quote: 天の美しさと雷の激しさに 大地が震撼。
Savoir suprême

items.text: Descent and return: from the sky to the pitch, from the throne to the team; the structure of his arc and of his entrances.

evidence.quote: like a divine descending from heavens
he decided to descend

items.text: Gold made human: the trading card text says he abandoned the brilliant style for a muddy, vigorous attitude, fighting through to the end.

evidence.quote: He has abandoned his previous brilliant style of play and has gained the strength to fight through to the end with a muddy, vigorous attitude.

items.text: The core tension: being treated as a god versus choosing to be one of the team. The brand should hold both: graceful and approachable.

evidence.quote: There are some things that you can only gain by losing.
O hallowed god Aphrody...

items.text: Beauty versus sweat: elegance is real, but it is earned by training, not given.

evidence.quote: he re-trained himself from the bottom up, gaining a new power that came from the deepest level of gymnastics
